timingNote: trainSeconds = this run (the exported weights). trainSecondsCpu / trainSecondsCuda = the same script, data and hyperparameters (batch 256, Adam 1e-3, patience 10) on each device; the CPU figure comes from a separate run whose weights are not exported, and its early stopping may end at a different epoch.
memoryMethod: trainMemoryMeasuredMB = torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() during the training loop minus the GPU memory allocated before it (psutil not installed; GPU tensors only, not host RAM). trainMemoryAnalyticMB = analytical estimate (the like-for-like figure): params x 4 B x (weights + grad + 2 Adam states) + 2 x batch(256) x activations(140) x 4 B.
